demo.title: giftedstock.txt
demo.code:
You: buy 2 normal stock mystery boxes on Base with USDC on Gifted Stock
Agent: (gets the plan from giftedstock.com and checks both steps: an exact 0.2 USDC approval for the normal box, then the buy)
       2 normal boxes for 0.20 USDC on Base. Send?
You: yes
Agent: Done: 2 sealed boxes in your wallet.
You: open them
Agent: (opens both: each pays a stock token to your wallet)
You: gift $1 of NVDAc to a link for 3 friends
Agent: (makes a fresh link key where it runs, checks the gift box steps, sends after your yes and gives you the share URL)

setup: Turn on MFA (a passkey or an authenticator app), then "Enable arbitrary contract calls" (bankr.bot, Security): every step is a contract call, and Bankr allows contract calls only with MFA on
Hold ETH for gas on the chain you use, Base or Robinhood Chain: raw transactions are not sponsored

Check your other Bankr Security settings before a gift, a send of boxes or a payment in ETH: the daily and per-transaction limits count the ETH a step sends, Allow NFT transfers can count boxes that leave the wallet
Ask: buy a normal stock mystery box on Base with USDC, open my boxes, swap 5 USDC to NVDAc on Gifted Stock or gift $1 of NVDAc to a wallet
Every step is checked before it is sent: pinned contracts and functions, exact approvals, the fee and its wallet (verify.mjs in the repo)
